title: Flowers & plants
blurb: Flowers for gifts and what they mean, Lunar New Year plants, and today's favourite houseplants.

groups.name: Flowers & what they say
groups.intro: Handy before you buy a bouquet.

items.name: Rose
items.what: The classic: red for romance, pink for thanks, yellow for friendship.

items.name: Tulip
items.what: Cup-shaped spring flower, the symbol of the Netherlands.

items.name: Peony
items.what: Lush, many-petalled blooms; China's 'king of flowers'.

items.name: Moth orchid
items.what: Long-lasting orchid on arching stems; the classic gift for shop openings and Lunar New Year.

items.name: Lily
items.what: Big fragrant trumpet flowers; white lilies are common at Western funerals.

items.name: Chrysanthemum
items.what: In Hong Kong and much of Asia white and yellow ones mean funerals, so don't give them as a gift. Also Japan's imperial emblem.

items.name: Sunflower
items.what: Big yellow head that follows the sun when young.

items.name: Hydrangea
items.what: Big pom-pom heads; the colour depends on how acidic the soil is.

items.name: Carnation
items.what: Ruffled flowers; pink and red are the Mother's Day flower.

items.name: Cherry blossom
items.what: Japan's sakura, blooming late March to early April; picnics under them are hanami.

groups.name: Lunar New Year plants
groups.intro: What Hong Kong flower markets sell before Chinese New Year, and why.
groups.hk: The Victoria Park Lunar New Year fair is the city's biggest flower market.

items.name: Peach blossom
items.what: Pink blossom branches, said to bring romance and good relationships.

items.name: Kumquat tree
items.what: Potted tree heavy with little gold fruit; the name sounds like 'gold' and 'luck'.

items.name: Narcissus
items.what: Fragrant white 'Chinese sacred lily' grown in bowls of pebbles.

items.name: Lucky bamboo
items.what: Twisted or tiered stalks in water; the number of stalks carries meaning (avoid four).

items.name: Pussy willow
items.what: Branches of soft silver buds, often decorated with red.

items.name: Gladiolus
items.what: Tall spikes of flowers that open upwards, for rising fortune.

groups.name: Houseplants
groups.intro: The plants on every interior Instagram.

items.name: Monstera
items.what: Big glossy leaves with holes and splits: the 'Swiss cheese plant'.

items.name: Fiddle-leaf fig
items.what: Tall plant with large violin-shaped leaves; famously fussy.

items.name: Snake plant
items.what: Upright stiff striped leaves; almost impossible to kill.

items.name: Pothos
items.what: Trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves.

items.name: Peace lily
items.what: Dark leaves with white flower hoods; droops dramatically when thirsty.

items.name: Bird of paradise
items.what: Flowers shaped like a tropical bird's head; big banana-like leaves indoors.

items.name: Money tree
items.what: Braided trunk with hand-shaped leaves; a popular feng shui gift.

items.name: Bonsai
items.what: Miniature trees trained and pruned in shallow pots.
